name: dex-Refspatial-Bench
description: Benchmark for spatial referring-expression and grounding tasks: given an image and a referring expression involving spatial relations, models must identify or localize the described object or region. It measures fine-grained spatial reasoning and grounding abilities in multimodal models, including robustness to varied spatial phrasing and cluttered scenes.
reputation: A targeted benchmark for spatial referring tasks with modest adoption in the multimodal/vision-language research community.
